question: Which of the following antifungals is used in the treatment of invasive aspergillosis and severe candidiasis including Candida krusei and Candida glabrata ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Voriconazole -> effective against invasive aspergillosis -> used in severe candidiasis including Candida krusei and Candida glabrata -> 95% CHAIN: Fluconazole -> effective against severe candidiasis including Candida krusei and Candida glabrata -> used in invasive aspergillosis -> 95%
analysis: Voriconazole is the antifungal medication used in the treatment of invasive aspergillosis and severe candidiasis including Candida krusei and Candida glabrata.
